A sovereign digital commerce stack typically consists of GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. NOWPayments provides automatic on-chain crypto payment verification with a 0.5% fee, allowing creators to receive payments in over 300 cryptocurrencies.
